book.name: Lukas
book.title: Xoulek Nimza wei Lukas byex o

content: Kwa nilul mi wo nol wou wongeingis
Yesu neil wou e xe xel betiyeing bei: “Lul leimalei wei embei bong xomaxoneing detei en sewokeing eno tyek qandi. Ekom tambiy tiwei wong etyip eno e gyaleeng.

Wangwei tambiy ti embei bong yakyak on ti detei en sewokeing, on inyon nimza bei xel banex e na eivek mamileeng is qakous ngandoung wei xel tup e vivekwou e kwa yo en e se bong kwa yon. Anutu tyek bong myaveweeng ngandoung ghanaw veil en ingwei xel wong o.
Om xam ghe gweiteyei xow. “Wangwei lim bong sewokeing ond wang na pepyawexe e, ek wangwei e pekwi xow ond wa semaleeng sewokeing wei e yo.
De wangwei e bong sewokeing lim yuw wou wang lek bouk tixemou, de lu lim yuw eno loumelam wou wang me neil embei, ‘A pekwi xow,’ ond wa semaleeng sewokeing wei e yo.”
Yesu neil kwa wei wongeingis o
Xel sinale neil wou Tambiy Ngandoung bei, “Wa tetulexe xa xe wongeingis ena bo ngandoung!”

Moxo neil elox bei, “Wangwei wongeingis wei xam eno nayaka nambei xax mastet vei on tyek wa neil wou xax ngandoung tine bei wa puw xow me ghe na dev xow eivek mamileeng on tyek betiwou wa xe qayeeng.”
Xuk nimza wei xukxe yo
“Wangwei xam on ti xe xukxe la qandax tembuing o la yeiteyei sipsip, gyeik ingwei xukxe loumelam, on tyek wa se teyei bei neil wou bei, ‘Lam dei me wa.’
Ekom tyek wa neil wou wa xe xukxe bei, ‘Wang gweiwou lul yaeing wou ay atax me ghe gweiwou xow me na duw lul yaeing en a gha me na num lek boy, dekakom wang gwa me na num lek.’
De tyek e neil dange wou xukxe en ingwei wo xuk ambei ingwei neil wou e yo? Ma.

Om xam is ambei nyon, gyeik ingwei xam ghe bong xuk dalus wei Anutu neil wou xam bei xam ghe bong o na ma, ond xam a neimbei, ‘Xa xukxe ne se nimza teyei lek. Xuk wei xa mi wong ne inye xuk wei xa mi yo.’”
Yesu wong vanei lepa ma veil moux xoumeeng
Yesu betiwou sakwaing wei la Yerusalem o, om la wou sakwaing wei di yeip senghoing eivek distrik Samaria me Galili yo.
Ka moxo la eivek beyeeng ti eno moux xoumeeng wei vanei lepa wong xel eno la tyip wou e nanghei inyon, xel nale dingta,
me taxe xoulekeing bei, “Yesu! Teiv! Pyanaleim en xa!”
Gyeik ingwei Yesu yei xel, eno neil wou xel, “Xam la talex xow wou xel lumuki.” Ka xel di la eno xel ninavi wo nimzalek.
Gyeik xel on ti yei ingwei wo nimzalek, om loumelam wou Yesu, moxo di taxe me sanghoxe Anutu.
Moxo ev vaxakatu eivek me ma la eivek tembuing wou Yesu vaxa me wo dange wou e, inyon Samaria ti.
Yesu teling, “Inye xel xoumeeng dalus se wo nimzalek? Xel limvey la nya?
Xelti se pekwi ma me loumelam sanghoxe Anutu, qe tambiy ba tine venaxow.”
Woyom Yesu neil wou, “Qandi lek me la. Wa xe wongeingis wong wang wo nimzalek.”
Anutu xe tete lalei tyek nam
Xel Parisi valu teling wou Yesu bei, “Gyeik inya Anutu xe tete lalei nam?” Yesu neil elox wou xel, “Anutu xe tete lalei embei nam, on tyek lulti se nam mendei nambei dee me xam ghe gwei lek mamim.
O tyek xomaxoneing se neimbei, ‘Toundei inye,’ o ‘Toundei inyei,’ en nambei Anutu xe tete lalei toundei eivek xam.”
Woyom moxo neil wou e xe xel betiyeing bei, “Bouk di lam gyeik ingwei xam ghe wou naleimim being gwei Xomaxoneing Neu Moux xe bouk ti. Ekom tyek xam seng gwei.
Xomaxoneing tyek na neil wou xam bei, ‘Moxo toundei inyei’ o ‘Moxo toundei inye!’ On xam se daveimyamim me ghe na betiy xel.
En bouk wei Xomaxoneing Neu Moux embei noum eno tyek nambei zivip mi nex mema nanghei tyoung myasepu valu me ela valu yo.
Ekom myaxeeng eno tyek na qou myavanei ngenong, me xomaxoneing wei bouk tine eno tyek pesek e.
“Kwa wei xel wong gyeik bouk wei Noaka yo, on nambei nyon tyek xel nox bong kwa kayon lek bouk wei Xomaxoneing Neu Moux embei noum o.
Xomaxoneing di ya me num lek me di iima, me neuyeiw di iima lox me loum deka ela tyip wou bouk wei Noaka la eivek sip, woyom memiing butek me lam leis xel dalus.
“Xel wong kwa kayon nambei nyon eivek bouk wei Lot o, xomaxoneing di ya me num lek, me di xouv lulul, me di wong vateivek, xel di ev lulul vei eivek xuk, me xel di ev xomek.
Ekom ka bouk wei Lot la veil Sodom, nenyex is qakous wei wo gyand en nenyex tum lek o tei nambei luing nanghei tyoung nei me ya moux alis vex dalus.
“Tyek xel bong kwa nambei nyon lek bouk wei Xomaxoneing Neu Moux embei noum yanyateiv o.

Lek bouk kayon, xelti embei toumendei lek xomek demi qetyei de e xe lulul nimza na toumendei eivek xomek lalei on tyek se douk me nox a qou lulul. De nambei nyon is, xelti embei toumendei eivek xuk on tyek se nox a qou e xe lulul ti.
Xam ghe bou naleimim en Lot venei!
Xelti embei zeimaxoun mapieing wei e yo, on tyek na saing e xe mapieing, ek xelti embei saing mapieing wei e yo, on tyek na zeimaxoun e xe mapieing.
A neil wou xam, lek boukeing tiyon eno tambiy yayuw di yeip lek zek tixemou, tyek Anutu na qou nge de nge na toumendei.
Vex yayuw di louk wit neing bei embo palawa wei belet o. Tyek Anutu na qou nge de nge na toumendei.”
Xel betiyeing teling, “Tambiy Ngandoung, lul on tyek qandi nanghei inya?” Moxo neil elox, “Lek beyeeng wei meyeing neing mi yeip lek o, inyon tyek xel menek tuw qeku nak inyon.”

footnotes.text: -36 Xel lupeyei valu wounalei bei qayeeng veweeng toundei is, lek danghei tine. Qayeeng tine eno nambei nye, “Moux yayuw di wong xuk. Tyek Anutu a qou nge de nge na toumendei.”
